newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castoroil prices regain in late buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castoroil prices regain in late buying.

text.p: Indian castorseed December delivery prices regained the initiative in late buying on Monday after an early fall by nine rupees to 1,119 rupees per quintal, dealers said.
"Shippers are short and they are covering positions ahead of fresh shipments," one dealer said. "The market may bounce back."
Groundnut oil fell to 414/415 rupees per 10 kg from 424/425 rupees on higher new crop arrivals. "After recent rains, the sun is out we expect higher new crop arrivals," he said.
Rajkot spot oil fell by 30/35 to 560 rupees per 15 kg.
